requirements.summary: Search the catalogue for query, visit the first at most ten products in observed order, preserve missing fields, write their observed values to a workbook and close the browser even on failure.

outcomes.description: Search the catalogue using the sole public query input.
Collect at most the first ten products in observed order, without deduplication or sponsored filtering.
Visit every selected product and extract its observed name, description and price; preserve missing fields.
Write an actual Excel workbook at the approved destination.
Close the browser on success and verified failure.

tasks.objective: Open the catalogue and capture the complete bounded producer observation before any interaction.

From every page of the complete initial observationSnapshot.pages, extract only immediate consumer facts: CAPTCHA evidence, compatible consent activation controls, and fill-compatible search controls. Retain producer reference identity, deterministic original page/record IDs, and completeness metadata; do not make a global decision here.

Create one-level flattened candidate views from the per-page initial extraction. This is pure data adaptation: one actual array-of-arrays level is flattened, and producer observations remain retained in open_catalogue.

Using only the compact initial offered view, detect observed CAPTCHA evidence and choose at most one compatible consent candidate by observed candidateId. Return candidate IDs only; do not return raw references as decisions.
Lookup the selected consent ID first in the offered consent candidate view, preserving null when no compatible observed control was selected.
If an observed compatible consent control was selected and the initial compact facts do not show CAPTCHA, activate the resolved original reference.
Activate the consent control resolved from the retained observed candidate reference.
Read the current the catalogue page after any consent handling with a fresh complete bounded observation so references are current.

From every page of the fresh ready-home observationSnapshot.pages, extract only immediate consumer facts: CAPTCHA evidence and fill-compatible search controls. Retain producer reference identity, deterministic original page/record IDs, and completeness metadata.
Create one-level flattened ready-home candidate views for decision and lookup without passing raw page sources to interpretation.
Using only the compact ready-home offered view, detect observed CAPTCHA evidence and choose one compatible search-fill candidateId. Return observed candidate IDs only.
Lookup the selected ready-home search target ID in the offered view, preserving the original observed reference and compatibility metadata.
Submit the public input query in the resolved observed the catalogue search field unless a CAPTCHA or missing compatible search control prevents it.
Fill the observed catalogue search input with the public query and submit the search.
Capture the current page after actual search submission, or the blocked page if search could not be submitted, as a complete bounded observation.

From every page of the complete search-result observationSnapshot.pages, extract only immediate consumer facts: CAPTCHA evidence and observed product-link candidates in display order, with producer IDs, original indices, resolved URLs and follow-compatible references when present. Do not rank, deduplicate, filter sponsored/organic, sample, or invent URLs.
Create one-level flattened search offered/original views from page-level arrays; this is pure data adaptation and preserves order, repeated candidates, original IDs, URLs and action arguments.

Using only the complete compact product candidate view, decide the first at-most-10 observed product candidate IDs in observed order. Return IDs only; do not rank, deduplicate, filter, synthesize URLs, or include raw page input.

Lookup selected product IDs first in the offered candidate view, then in retained original records; preserve repeated selections, order, original action arguments and observed URLs. Do not synthesize missing URLs or references.
Visit each resolved product URL sequentially, one product per selected candidate, preserving selected order and original index; extract one non-null compact product record per item.
Open the current selected product URL and capture a complete bounded observation snapshot for that product.

From every page of the complete product observationSnapshot.pages, extract only immediate consumer facts: CAPTCHA evidence and observed name, description, and price candidates. Retain the complete producer observation separately in read_product_page and preserve completeness metadata.

Using only the compact product-page facts and current candidate metadata, choose observed name, description and price values when present; otherwise set nullable fields to null and explain absence in status. Return exactly one non-null product record for this visited product; never invent content or evidence.

Deterministically project the visited non-null compact product records to the exact accepted products interface in observed order, with no interpretation, no raw sources, no additional fields, minItems 0 and maxItems 10. Preserve nullable name, description, price and url within each non-null record and required index/status.

Aggregate observed CAPTCHA detections from compact stage outputs only, including initial, ready-home, search-results and product-page booleans. Do not inspect raw page input or invent CAPTCHA when acquisition was merely empty/unusable.

Create one explicit bounded TSV payload for the .xlsx writer from only the at-most-ten compact normalized product records and compact aggregate status. Preserve exact observed names, descriptions and prices, row order, and represent nulls as missing cells. Normalize embedded tabs/newlines in cell values. Include columns supported by document_write: index, name, description, price, url, status.
Write the TSV-formatted extracted product records to the fixed authorized Excel workbook path inside the workspace.
Expose the workbook path only from the successful document writer output after typed success and non-null filePath assertions.

always.objective: Close the browser page/context even if any previous navigation, extraction, CAPTCHA handling, product visit, or file-writing step fails.
